requirements.quote:
The server uses a HANDSHAKE_DONE frame (type=0x1e) to signal
   confirmation of the handshake to the client.
requirements.condition: When a server sends a HANDSHAKE_DONE frame to a client
requirements.required_behavior: The frame signals confirmation of the handshake and has frame type 0x1e.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inspect the encoded frame type and verify that client processing treats the frame as handshake confirmation.

requirements.quote:
HANDSHAKE_DONE frames are formatted as shown in Figure 44, which
   shows that HANDSHAKE_DONE frames have no content.
requirements.condition: When encoding or parsing a HANDSHAKE_DONE frame
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Including content in a HANDSHAKE_DONE frame is forbidden.
requirements.why_checkable: The frame encoding can be inspected to verify that nothing follows its type as frame content.

requirements.condition: When encoding or recognizing a HANDSHAKE_DONE frame
requirements.required_behavior: The Type field is encoded as integer value 0x1e.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using any other frame type value for a HANDSHAKE_DONE frame is forbidden.
requirements.why_checkable: The frame type value is directly observable in the wire encoding or parser dispatch.

requirements.quote: A HANDSHAKE_DONE frame can only be sent by the server.  Servers MUST
requirements.required_behavior: Only a server sends the frame.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: A client must not send a HANDSHAKE_DONE frame.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation test can verify that the client never emits this frame and that the send path is restricted to the server role.

requirements.quote:
A HANDSHAKE_DONE frame can only be sent by the server.  Servers MUST
   NOT send a HANDSHAKE_DONE frame before completing the handshake.  A
requirements.condition: Before the server has completed the handshake
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The server must not send a HANDSHAKE_DONE frame.
requirements.why_checkable: A state-aware test can observe whether the server emits this frame before entering the handshake-complete state.

requirements.quote:
server MUST treat receipt of a HANDSHAKE_DONE frame as a connection
   error of type PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
requirements.condition: When a server receives a HANDSHAKE_DONE frame
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The server must not accept or normally process the received frame.
requirements.error_behavior: The server must treat receipt as a connection error of type PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver the frame to a server and verify that it raises a connection-level PROTOCOL_VIOLATION error.
